newsitem.title: USA: AMF BOWLING CENTERS SAYS BUYING 15 BOWLING CENTERS.
newsitem.headline: AMF BOWLING CENTERS SAYS BUYING 15 BOWLING CENTERS.

text.p: AMF Bowling Centers Inc said Friday that it has agreed to purchase 15 bowling centers from the Conbow Corp.
The private company did not disclose terms of the transaction.
The purchase brings the total number of AMF bowling centers to 343 nationwide.
Conbow Corp is based in Amherst, N.Y.

In addition to the Conbow Purchase, AMF said it has finalized a deal to purchase five Ebonite Recreation Centers, all in Florida. AMF added that Ebonite International, a bowling ball manufacturer, was not included in this agreement.
